task: AF-RES-016 Q3: Hooper (1965) and Markey (1984) original-body retrieval supplement
scope: Targeted additional search only. Existing reliability-sources.json and reliability-notes.md were not modified. No coding files or AF-RES-013–015 results were read.

result.interpretation: The two specified original-body requirements remain unverified. Public follow-on works, bibliographies, author-link metadata, and an unavailable-full-text notice do not satisfy them.

target_status.finding: Searches found citations and later applications of consistency coefficients, but no directly readable original report or conference-paper scan. Bibliographic trails contain TR95-56 and TR-95-96; the original cover was not available to resolve this discrepancy.
target_status.minimal_next_action: Obtain a normally accessible public IBM or FID 1965 scan, verify the cover/title/report identifier first, then read the original definition, experimental unit and results tables. Re-run the exact-title query with the verified identifier only when a new public copy or URL is available.
target_status.cannot_claim: Neither the original experimental percentage nor an original definition/page location has been verified in this supplemental search.

target_status.target: Markey (1984), Interindexer consistency tests: A literature review and report of a test of consistency in indexing visual materials, Library & Information Science Research 6(2):155–177
target_status.finding: The publisher issues route returned 403, the ERIC record was inaccessible, the institution-linked author site returned no body text, and the public ResearchGate record explicitly reported that no full text was available. No request to the author or sign-in was attempted.
target_status.minimal_next_action: Read a public author or institutional copy of the 1984 article, pp. 155–177, if a new public URL becomes available. Check the methods and results for participant count, image count, term-versus-concept scoring and comparison-pair selection before using any numerical benchmark.
target_status.cannot_claim: Secondary descriptions of the participant count were not reconciled, and no original result or method is counted as confirmed.

supporting_reads.source_type: government workshop proceedings; later methodological application
supporting_reads.title: CENDI Indexing Workshop, NASA Conference Publication 10160
supporting_reads.sections_read: Overview and Evaluation/Criteria for Evaluating Inter-Indexer Consistency, printed pp. 78–88 (PDF pp. 90–99), especially the coefficient definitions on printed p. 88
supporting_reads.confirmed: The later workshop material defines pair consistency using term agreements divided by unique assigned terms and group consistency as a mean of pair coefficients. It cites Rodgers (1961) and Hooper (1965) as antecedents. This is a later application, not a reproduced Hooper report.
supporting_reads.limits: Does not establish what Hooper's original report said or resolve the report-number discrepancy. Term-set overlap is not the same denominator as agreement on one role label per sampled unit.

supporting_reads.source_type: institutional technical report; original indexing experiment unrelated to target retrieval
supporting_reads.title: Use of Data-Base Access for Interindexer Communication and for Indexer Training
supporting_reads.sections_read: Title, introduction, methods, Test of Usefulness for Interindexer Consistency and results in the first four PDF pages
supporting_reads.confirmed: The report studies indexer communication and training using a database reference file. Its experiment involves six indexers, two sets of ten papers, and a reference file with 205 items and 470 descriptors. Access to others' indexing is an intervention affecting consistency, not an independent blind-coding condition.
supporting_reads.limits: This is not Hooper (1965) or Markey (1984). A subsequent find request for the Hooper reference returned 502, so no exact reference-section wording is asserted. The body was readable in the earlier open, but the target originals were not obtained.
